purpose: Derive canonical financial obligations from completed WORK_ITEM state only when source evidence resolves an exact payable amount and payment basis.
fail_closed: OPEN or IN_PROGRESS work does not create an obligation.
DONE without completion evidence does not create an obligation.
Range-priced work does not auto-create an obligation until the exact amount is resolved.
Per-unit work does not auto-create an obligation until the performed quantity is resolved.
An existing stable obligation is not duplicated.
No FINANCIAL_MOVEMENT is created from work completion.
